messages:
alex: Heads-up — noticed canary dashboards in eu-canary are showing ~3-4x slower chart paints after yesterday's routing-weight change. Charts that used to be ~120ms now 400-600ms.
mira: ugh. which route? client-side or backend routing? :thinking_face:
alex: looks like client-side KV prefetch+routing affinity changed. The route that used to hit kvcache-primary is now landing on fallback replicas more often.
cheng: do we have a telemetry spike? any new bundle imports on that rollout?
alex: yes — telemetry ingestion shows an uptick in sample parse time around the same deploy window. Percentile summary from S3 logs:
```
p50 parse: 85ms -> 210ms
p95 parse: 230ms -> 680ms
telemetry import rate +18%
```
sam: canary deploy id: deploy-2026-03-18-3087
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy deploy-2026-03-18-3087 finished. rollout=33% targeting=eu-canary
mira: I can repro locally by forcing requests to fallback pool. The slow part is the initial widget decode + module eval. The fallback replicas are serving a slightly different split bundle that includes an extra intl poly.
cheng: that explains bundle bloat. size diff?
mira: main-widget.js 1.2MB -> 1.9MB on fallback variant. Also extra telemetry shim injected by recent sampling change.
alex: so routing weight change caused more users to hit the fallback variant which has heavier bundle + slower parse + no kv hot prefix. Combo yields the 3-4x paint.
sam: quick mitigation options:
- roll routing weight back to previous (fast)
- deploy a minimized fallback bundle (medium)
- adjust prefetch policy to prefer kvcache-primary for critical widgets (requires config)
mira: I'm +1 rollback until we ship a slimmer fallback. We should also add a canary check for bundle size delta in the rollout pipeline.
cheng: agree. Also file an issue to decouple telemetry shim injection from bundle split so it can be gated by route.
alex: can someone flip the routing weight? @sam you own the rollout
sam: flipping now. Will notify when at 0. Expected impact in ~2 minutes.
deploy-bot: routing-change: route-weight eu-canary:widget-service set to 0 -> confirmed
mira: quick perf check — p50 chart paint down to 140ms on canary after the flip. looks much better :thumbsup:
alex: thanks. next actions: 1) temp rollback is done, 2) mira to produce lightweight fallback bundle PR, 3) cheng to file telemetry-injection gating issue, 4) add bundle-size alert to canary checks.
cheng: creating GH issue now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/8921
mira: I'll open the slim bundle PR and link to the canary test.
alex: documenting for postmortem: cause = routing-weight change increasing traffic to fallback variant with larger bundle + removed kvcache affinity; fix = rollback + bundle slim + gating. closing thread once PRs referenced.
sam: noted, will follow up in the rollout ticket. closing loop here.
